title: Number of Installments in a Fine Arts Payment Plan Opened Late in the Year (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
**Installment count of the plan.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the first installment of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** is due on the date it is paid and the plan's later installments fall on the same day of the following months, none after 2027-03-31.

The plan's number of installments is:

- the number of monthly due dates from the first installment through 2027-03-31, when the type offers the installment plan, the plan total is at least the installment threshold and that number is below the type's installment count;
- 1, when the type offers no installment plan or the plan total is below the installment threshold;
- the type's installment count otherwise.

For the Fine Arts Performing Ensemble the payment terms are: installment plan offered; installment count 3; installment threshold 150.00.

## Cases (hypothetical first-installment dates, plan total of at least 150.00)

| First installment paid on | Monthly due dates through 2027-03-31 | Number of installments |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-12-15 | 4 (December to March) | 3, the installment count |
| 2027-01-20 | 3 (01-20, 02-20, 03-20) | 3, the installment count |
| 2027-02-10 | 2 (02-10, 03-10) | 2 |
| 2027-03-31 | 1 | 1 |

**Threshold.** A plan total of 149.99 is below 150.00 and the number of installments is 1, whatever the date; 150.00 meets the threshold.
